_doc: Inspired by docs.ultracite.ai/hooks — auto-format frontend files after AI edits. Backs to the project's own ESLint config since the Ultracite preset's TSX parsing didn't work cleanly with our Next.js + react-day-picker stack.

hooks.command: sh -c 'jq -r .tool_input.file_path 2>/dev/null | grep -q "/frontend/" && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && bun run lint -- --fix --quiet 2>&1 | tail -10 || true'
